title: 第二十一章 染上欲色第二十二章 骑虎难下
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
月翎拼尽全力，可在那片浩瀚的精神域面前，她那点精神力不过是杯水车薪。
撑不住了。
她快速抽手，大口喘着气，额头沁出一层薄汗：“只能帮到这儿了，你自求多福吧。”
说完，她慢慢撑着地站起来，脚步有些凌乱地走出树林。
直到那道纤细的身影消失在夜色里，躺在地上的泽禹才缓缓坐直身体。
他脸上哪还有半点精神域崩溃的模样？
从头到尾都是他装的。
只要不战斗，那支抑制剂足够保证他清醒十天。
他之所以演这一出，是因为潜意识里的猜测。
他总觉得自己污染值降低，和这个低阶雌性有关。
看见她的瞬间，他就决定试一试。
而那股涌入精神域的熟悉暖意，让他彻底确认了。
就是她！
那个在废弃教学楼里帮了他一把，让他没有彻底沦为野兽的雌性。
家族动用一切力量，也只得到一个结论：他必须和s级以上的雌性结侣，通过长期交欢才能逐渐净化精神域。
可一个低阶雌性，甚至没有和他交欢，竟然做到了？
他抬眼看向她离开的方向，眼底的震动久久未散。
如果让帝国那些家族知道，洛克郡一个不起眼的小雌性可以做到，她会面临什么？
被抢破头？还是被当成工具囚禁起来？
泽禹握了握垂在身侧的拳头，谁敢抢一个试试。

她，是他先遇见的，就是他的！
月翎回到宿舍时，刚抬手要推门，门就被人从里面拉开，罗珊的脸撞进视线。
月翎注意到她额头有两处擦伤，其他地方倒看不出什么。
罗珊也看到了她，眼底的愤恨几乎要遮掩不住，“你……回来了？”
可下一秒，罗珊垂头，往旁边移步让出了通道。
月翎才发现她走路不太利索，垂着的手指也红肿一片。
看样子昨天吃了不小的苦头，就是不知道这个教训够不够？
这些念头在脑子里转了一圈，月翎脸上露出恰到好处的关切：“罗珊，你这是怎么了？”
罗珊咬了咬牙：“不小心摔了一跤。”
月翎嘴角轻轻动了动：“那你下次可要小心。
受点小伤不要紧，可别吃了大亏。”
罗珊瞳孔缩了一下，月翎这是在警告她？
昨天她看见自己了？
她抬起头想确认一下，可月翎已经从她身前走过，转眼就去了浴室。
舒舒服服洗了个澡，月翎躺回床上。
有了几次经验，她很快沉入梦境。
眼前是一间灰暗的房间，光线微弱，只能隐约看见床上有一团凸起。
不用想，就知道那是泽禹。
月翎赶紧迈步靠近。
可刚走了两步，脚下忽然一绊，整个人往前扑去。

疼得她呲了呲牙，伸手去捂脚。
这才发现，身上穿着轻薄的纱裙，她是被拖地的裙摆给绊倒的。
她下意识低头打量自己，几乎什么也包不住。
想到这梦境是按雄性喜好来的，她脸颊就微微发烫。
没想到那个精神力都快崩溃的雄性竟然有这样的喜好。
content_en:
Yue Ling tried her best, but in front of that vast spiritual realm, her little mental power was just a drop in the bucket.
I can't hold it any longer.
She quickly pulled her hands away, gasping for air, and a thin layer of sweat broke out on her forehead: "This can only help you so much, just ask for your own blessings."
After saying that, she slowly stood up and walked out of the woods with a somewhat messy step.
It wasn't until the slender figure disappeared into the night that Ze Yu, who was lying on the ground, slowly sat up straight.
Is there any sign of mental collapse on his face?
He was pretending from beginning to end.
As long as he doesn't fight, the inhibitor is enough to keep him awake for ten days.
The reason why he performed this act was because of his subconscious guess.
He always felt that the decrease in his pollution level was related to this low-level female.
The moment he saw her, he decided to give it a try.
And the familiar warmth that poured into the spiritual realm made him completely confirmed.
That's her!
The female who helped him in the abandoned teaching building and prevented him from completely turning into a beast.
The family used all their strength, but only came to one conclusion: he must marry an S-level or above female, and through long-term intercourse, the spiritual realm can be gradually purified.
But a low-level female did it without even having sex with him?
He raised his eyes and looked in the direction she left, the shock in his eyes lingering for a long time.
If those families in the empire knew that an inconspicuous little female from Rock County could do it, what would she face?
Got your head robbed? Or was he imprisoned as a tool?
Ze Yu clenched his fist hanging by his side, asking whoever dared to grab one to try.
She was the one he met first, and she was his!
When Yueling returned to the dormitory, as soon as she raised her hand to push the door open, the door was opened from the inside, and Luo Shan's face came into view.
Yue Ling noticed two scratches on her forehead, but there was nothing visible elsewhere.
Luo Shan also saw her, and the resentment in her eyes could hardly be concealed, "You...are back?"
But the next second, Luo Shan lowered her head and moved to the side to make way for the passage.
Only then did Yue Ling realize that she was not walking smoothly and her hanging fingers were red and swollen.
It seems that I suffered a lot yesterday, but I don’t know if this lesson is enough?
These thoughts went around in her mind, and Yue Ling's face showed just the right amount of concern: "Roshan, what's wrong with you?"
Luo Shan gritted her teeth: "I accidentally fell."
Yue Ling's mouth moved slightly: "Then you should be careful next time.
It doesn't matter if you get a little injured, but don't suffer a big loss. "
Luo Shan's pupils shrank, was Yue Ling warning her?
Did she see herself yesterday?
She raised her head to confirm, but Yue Ling had already passed by her and went to the bathroom in a blink of an eye.
After taking a comfortable bath, Yue Ling lay back on the bed.
After several experiences, she quickly fell into dreamland.
In front of him was a dark room with weak light, and he could only vaguely see a bulge on the bed.
Without thinking, I knew it was Ze Yu.
Yue Ling quickly stepped closer.
But just after taking two steps, he suddenly tripped under his feet and threw himself forward.
She gritted her teeth in pain and reached out to cover her feet.
Only then did she realize that she was wearing a thin gauze skirt, and she tripped over the floor-length skirt.
She subconsciously lowered her head and looked at herself, barely able to cover anything.
Her cheeks felt slightly hot when she thought that this dream was based on male preferences.
I didn't expect that the male whose mental strength was about to collapse would have such a preference.
